_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: a few turns with no distances, or a walk where the east and west parts cancel; 2: a walk to add up north–south and east–west, or places put on a map; 3: a walk that needs Pythagoras for the straight-line distance, a turn by an angle, or two people's walks compared; 4: shadows and the sun, a compass that has been turned, a clock dial used as a compass, or a walk worked backwards. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
